title: trk guidance --json
description: The response of `trk guidance <skill> --json`: a site's own guidance for one trk skill, read from `${TRK_GUIDANCE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/trk/guidance}/<skill>.md`. No file is the normal case (`present` false), not an error. A skill that is not trk's, or a file that is unreadable, not UTF-8 or over 64 KiB, exits 2. Additional fields are allowed.

path.description: The resolved file path, whether or not it exists.

sha256.description: Of the file's bytes; null when absent.

text.description: The file's text, unchanged; null when absent.
